climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A sparkling wine from the Marche, around Serrapetrona, San Severino Marche and Belforte del Chienti. It is a quality sparkling wine, with Vernaccia Nera among the allowed grapes.
